source_refs.note: g) Identification of Zinc radical (Zn²⁺): a main subheading of 16.7 Tests for identification of basic radicals, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 347-348.

blocks.text: Take 4 g solid sample in a clean test tube. Dissolve it in 10 cm³ of distilled water. Make two portions of the above solution for further tests.

blocks.caption: Identification of zinc radical
rows: To one portion add NaOH solution.
White precipitate is formed which is soluble in excess of NaOH solution.
To second portion of the above solution add aqueous ammonia.
White precipitate is formed which dissolves in excess of ammonia.
